capabilities: Schedule finish-to-start dependencies between parent and child tasks
Enforce hard deadlines and schedule children backward
Roll up parent durations and due dates from active children
Show a Gantt timeline with weekly intervals
Retain project colors across Kanban and Gantt views
disambiguation: Not a standalone task or project manager; it adds scheduling and a Gantt view on top of TaskNotes.
extras: Needs TaskNotes with runtime API v1 and the tasks.read, tasks.write and relationships.read capabilities; Google Calendar sync is delegated to TaskNotes, which keeps the OAuth credentials. Functional requirements and limitations are documented in Tasknotes-PM-requirements.md.
intentEvidence: Tasknotes-PM is an Obsidian companion plugin for TaskNotes.
problem: TaskNotes records tasks and project links but does not compute dependency schedules, roll up parent dates, or show a timeline.

relations.evidence: Tasknotes-PM is an Obsidian companion plugin for TaskNotes.
When Google Calendar sync is enabled, it asks the installed TaskNotes plugin to run TaskNotes' own local Google Calendar sync

summary: Companion plugin for TaskNotes that schedules finish-to-start project dependencies, enforces deadlines, and adds a Gantt timeline.
